g.title: Sheet.140
g.desc: The link between DS1 and DS2 fails: 1. DS2 puts all ports to ...
g.text: The link between DS1 and DS2 fails:1. DS2 puts all ports to Designated role.2. It says “I am the root”.3. ACC1 receives inferior BPDU (it still has connection to the primary root with lower BID).4. ACC1 sends a proposal to be Designated port on the segment and DS2 agrees to be Root port.
